reading.body:
CyrusOne Somerset (NYM1) discloses 23 MW of IT capacity across 185,000 square feet but no workload certifications or announced expansion, leaving its AI suitability unproven.

The facility publishes no certifications, so it cannot be verified for AI training or inference workloads. Its suitability score of 64 rests on only two inputs, published IT capacity and operator type, and omits announced expansion, making it a partial signal. The 23 MW translates to roughly 575 racks at 40 kW each or 290 at 80 kW, but actual rack density is not disclosed.

For AI scaling, the facility's role is indeterminate because tenant base and power consumption profile are not published. Its location in Somerset, New Jersey, near the New York metro market, is the only contextual clue, suggesting possible use for distributed inference or smaller training jobs rather than dedicated hyperscale clusters. The data does not show actual power draw, expansion plans, or certifications, so the published capacity cannot be treated as AI-ready capacity.
